messages:
Elaine (CEO): @here Quick update — we’ve scheduled a short all-hands this Wednesday 10:00am PT (45m). Agenda below; please skim and drop any Qs in this thread or submit anonymously via the form. Recording and slides will be posted afterward.

- Launch callouts: Redwood Optimize beta launch timeline and what teams need to do
- Policy update: small change to audit log retention and data export process (compliance notes)
- Incident recap: brief summary of last-week GPU cluster instability + mitigation plan
- Ops checklist for Dedicated customers (what we’re shipping next month)
- Hiring update and org changes (brief)
- Q&A (live)

Submit pre-reads & Qs here: https://forms.gle/redwood-allhands-ask (or reply in-thread). Recording link will be here after: https://redwood.company/recordings/2098765432 (placeholder)

Michael (Eng): Heads-up — I’ve got a conflict with 10:00–10:30, can we confirm if the first 15m are exec updates only?

Elaine (CEO): Good call. Plan is exec updates first 10–12m, then launch + ops deep dive. We’ll start precisely at 10:00.

Sara (Product): Can the product slides include the rollout timeline and known breaking changes for SDKs? I’ll drop the deck into the all-hands folder by Tue EOD.

Jamal (SRE): For the incident recap: I’ll bring a one-slide timeline + BLUF and link to the postmortem. Postmortem draft will be in incidents channel by Tue for review.

Alex (Ops): Ops checklist — I want 5 minutes to call out Dedicated customers who need manual verifications. Will prepare a short playbook snippet.

Lina (Comms): FYI — we’ll push a short blurb to the team digest after the meeting. If there are embargoed items for partners, DM me.

Michael (Eng): Also—remote dial-in? Can we confirm Teams/Zoom + Livestream link? Last time Livestream hit 2k viewers.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/2098765432 — includes Zoom + Stream link.

Elaine (CEO): Thanks everyone. Quick ask: if you want a specific question covered live, mark it with "URGENT" in the form or tag me in the thread. Otherwise we’ll prioritize pre-submitted product + ops questions. :thumbsup:

Sara (Product): Noted. I put two demo clips in the slide notes, one focused on latency improvements and one on cost controls.

Jamal (SRE): For transparency — the incident root cause was a kernel driver regression on certain node types. Mitigation: rolling kernel pin + improved early-warning for IO saturation. Will include exact rollback commands in the postmortem.

Alex (Ops): If anyone owns a Dedicated customer who experienced failures, please add their account ID to the post in incidents so we can confirm remediation before the all-hands.

Michael (Eng): If my calendar conflict is unavoidable I’ll send a 2m prerecord with the perf graphs for Elaine to play.

Elaine (CEO): Great. Last note — we’re trying a tightened Q&A format: 10 live questions, 5 follow-ups. If we can’t get to everything we’ll triage follow-ups in the thread and post a consolidated FAQ.

Lina (Comms): Slide deck link (coming Tuesday): https://notion.redwood.com/allhands/2098765432-deck

Michael (Eng): :thumbsup: Thanks.

Elaine (CEO): See you Wednesday. Please keep thread for Qs and pre-reads only — use the incidents channel for ongoing incident discussion.
